title: Jaipur wall collapse leaves at least three dead, with 15 labourers trapped
summary: A wall under construction in Jaipur's Amer area collapsed on Tuesday, leaving at least three people dead and 15 labourers trapped under debris. The incident occurred while the workers were working on the site. Rescue efforts are underway to save those trapped. The cause of the collapse is still unknown.
summary_points: A wall in Jaipur's Amer area collapsed, causing multiple fatalities and trapping labourers
At least three people have died in the incident, with 15 others feared trapped under debris
Rescue efforts are underway to save those trapped in the rubble
The cause of the collapse is currently unknown

framing.center: Centrist outlets are providing a balanced view of the incident, focusing on the facts and the rescue efforts underway. They are not taking a strong stance on the cause of the collapse or the government's response.
